reviews.author: Enrique Vargas
reviews.text: I spent $2,000 with Kingdom Landscaping and the experience was incredibly frustrating. I was told the job was complete, but when I checked, it clearly wasn’t. I had to call them back just to clean up, something that should’ve been done the first time. Even after they returned, the work still wasn’t fully completed. I voiced my concerns multiple times, but they were either ignored or I was lied to about things being finished. Completely unprofessional and not worth the money. I would not recommend them to anyone. Photos of above and beyond work provided

reviews.author: Hugo Gomez
reviews.text: Today I looked at 2 clean houses in front of my house and I told my neighbor how nice it was and he told me it's the kingdom landcasping company and I told him I'll go and congratulate them on how clean it looks. And I took my time. Good job!

reviews.author: Gloria J Methven
reviews.text: I have been using Kingdom Landscaping for 2 years now and I would highly recommend them. They take care of cutting my lawn and fall cleanup. Lyka and Justin have been there for me when I needed them. I will continue to use their services. Hope you will too.

reviews.author: Marc Codispoti
reviews.text: Justin and his crew did such a fabulous job with our Autumn cleanup yesterday. We are in awe at the time and patience provided to our lawn!!! Thank you so much. We highly recommend Kingdom Landscaping!!!

reviews.author: Robert Schultz
reviews.text: Darwin and the other guys we so amazing and professional. I don’t think they left one leaf. Kingdom was also so accommodating. Between contact and competition of job less than 24 hrs. I highly recommend for all yard needs.

reviews.author: Rick Szpakowski
reviews.text: Kingdom Landscaping came to do a fall cleanup of all of my leaves. They did a fantastic job. They have very courteous employees who understood my needs and executed flawlessly. I would highly recommend them for any landscaping needs!

reviews.author: Michael Gomm
reviews.text: As a customer of Kingdom Landscaping, I couldn’t be more satisfied with their exceptional service. From the initial consultation to the completion of the project, their professionalism and attention to detail were evident. The team transformed my overgrown yard into a beautiful, serene space that I now enjoy daily. They were punctual, courteous, and worked diligently to bring my vision to life. I appreciated their transparent pricing and the time they took to explain each step of the process. Their expertise in selecting the right plants and materials truly enhanced the aesthetic appeal of my property. Communication was seamless, and they promptly addressed any questions I had. It’s clear that Kingdom Landscaping takes pride in their work and values customer satisfaction. I highly recommend their services to anyone looking to elevate their outdoor space.

reviews.author: Kayla Gregorio
reviews.text: Incredibly frustrating experience with Kingdom Landscaping. I was a customer for a full season last year with little issues, they put me on a Saturday route. They would sometimes miss but somewhat okay. This year, they changed my service from Saturdays to Mondays. When I requested to be changed to a later day in the week, it took weeks of going back and forth for them to listen to me. They missed weeks at a time with no notice and no rescheduling. When I confronted them - they said one week it was because of staffing issues and the next week because every road to my house was blocked. Every road? That’s ridiculous. They take forever to email back with no solutions and when I reached my limit to cancel, I received a cancellation email immediately. I would never recommend them. They need to have better customer service and communication.

reviews.author: Andre Diaz
reviews.text: I’ve been using Kingdom Landscaping for lawn mowing the past two years, and the quality has been top-notch every time. Justin and his team are reliable, professional, and pay attention to every detail crisp edges, even cuts, and no mess left behind. They show up on time and keep my lawn looking perfect week after week. If you want a company that truly cares about their work, Kingdom Landscaping is the one to call!

reviews.author: Aiden Long
reviews.text: I recently hired Kingdom Landscaping to revitalize my overgrown yard, and the results were outstanding. Their team was punctual and professional, transforming my space into a serene retreat with a new patio and walkway. They even added a waterfall feature that has become the highlight of my garden. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend Kingdom Landscaping for anyone looking to enhance their outdoor space.

reviews.author: Cg Opara
reviews.text: I signed up with Kingdom Landscaping at the beginning of last year, and I’ve stuck with them ever since because they’re just that good. When I first reached out online, Lyka called me within an hour to go over everything, and the whole sign-up process was smooth and simple. The crew showed up the very next day, right on time, and absolutely transformed my lawn, super detail-oriented but still fast. Since then, they’ve been consistent, reliable, and never hit me with any surprise fees or headaches. If you want a landscaping service that actually cares and makes everything effortless, this is the one to go with.

reviews.author: Cindy Hedlund
reviews.text: Justin and his crew are exceptional. For a young group, they are extremely responsible and so respectful. No fooling around with these guys, they get the job done and do it well. One of the VERY FEW companies that show up when they are scheduled to and they do an awesome job on my HUGE lawn. I started with Kingdom Landscaping last year and will definitely be using them for many seasons to come. Thank you Justin! Sincerely, CH/Howell, NJ

reviews.author: Bill M
reviews.text: Scheduled snow removal with this company. I was told $75 up to 2 inches and $5 an inch after that. January 20th, no show and did it myself. This past storm, they show up hours after I ended up doing it. They shoveled 20 feet of my sidewalk and were there for 2 minutes, charged me $75. I reached out several times and they were unresponsive. I cancelled snow service and my lawn service with them. Finally, I get an email saying they’re sorry and will consider a refund. Still haven’t heard back and I followed up. Avoid!

reviews.author: Eugene Kiselev
reviews.text: Failed to show up for weeks in a row but kept charging my account through autopay. When I asked why they were mowing my lawn they claimed that they had and gave me dates and times that were just lies. And when they finally showed up for a make up mowing they dinged my car with rocks because they were not careful with the mowers. AVOID like the plague.

reviews.author: Mindy Mayerman Kolczynski
reviews.text: I am so happy to have found Justin at Kingdom Landscaping . His prices are very reasonable . Justin is extremely professional , more important, his work ethic is outstanding . Happy to say company offers Good quality work each week . Justin is always available if you need him very good communication skills . His customer service is outstanding always meeting our individual needs .

reviews.author: Dan Lahey
reviews.text: Justin and his employees did a great job for our property! We've used him for lawn mowing and also a special unique project which he was up for the challenge. Easy payment, prompt, and responsive. Not everyday you can support a young entrepreneur that takes a lot of pride in their work and vision. Best of luck to this growing business!

reviews.author: gary paratore
reviews.text: Justin has been my landscaper for a year now and I could not be happier with his work. He is awesome with communication through text and phone call and never leaves me disappointed. His prices are fair and I can appreciate the fact that he is a young entrepreneur with big goals. I would highly recommend his service for any of your lawn care needs.

reviews.author: Andy Thaw
reviews.text: I have been using Kingdom for my lawn service for about a year now and cannot say enough good things about them. They are reasonably priced, reliable and very clean. My yard always meets my expectations when they are done. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Melanie Shields
reviews.text: Justin does a great job with the lawn maintenance. He's very attentive to everything, always cleans up, and responsive if you have any questions. You can't beat the prices especially for the quality of work he does.

reviews.author: Thiery Andrews
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars I would! Working with the Kingdom Landscaping team was pure joy! Their work is amazing and absolutely beautiful! Everyone was kind, helpful and professional. I can’t say enough! If you have any landscaping needs, strongly encourage you to give them a call!!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Marino
reviews.text: Justin is pleasant, reliable, hardworking, responds immediately if one needs to contact him, and reasonably priced. He did my lawn all season and then my enormous leaf clean-up on the fall. Always a great job!

reviews.author: Jim Reinknecht
reviews.text: Last summer I saw them cutting my neighbors lawn, and he asked me if I wanted my lawn cut as well. I at first declined but the next week, after seeing the quality of work they were doing, I asked them for a quote. They not only mows my lawn now, my neighbors lawn, but also my brother's lawn as well. They are fantastic, prompt, easy to communicate with, and VERY fair on price. I'm putting my mower for sale this spring. I'm done mowing my lawn forever. These guys have my business from now on.

reviews.author: Santo Lombardo
reviews.text: They were on time, and began working right away. They were very professional and did a great job. I would highly recommend them for any services you need.

reviews.author: Kelly Soltysik
reviews.text: Our landscaper of several years retired and I was nervous to get someone new. We started last year and I have absolutely no regrets. Professional, responsive and does a great job. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laura Hirschberg
reviews.text: We’ve been working With Kingdom landscaping since the beginning. We highly recommend. Incredible customer service.

reviews.author: Joe Falco
reviews.text: Justin and his team were awesome this past Fall helping out with leaf cleanup. The guys were all super professional. They were able to come out right away and get the job done fast with superb quality.

reviews.author: Gwendolyn Love
reviews.text: Justin is reliable and responds quickly to my text. I've received many compliments from neighbors about my lawn and have recommended Justin each time. His work is good and he accepts suggestions on any changes I make with a good attitude. G. L.

reviews.author: Amy Dunphy
reviews.text: Justin was born to be a business owner and entrepenuer. How do I know? I’m his mom! Coming from a family with 10 kids, Justin has learned to be independent and hard working from a young age. He spends his spare time thinking of new ways to make your yard better! He loves to go the extra mile to please his customers. You can rely on him as he is the first person out the door in the morning to make sure YOU the customer get your job done! Not only is Justin reliable but his team is made up hard workers whom I personally know are eager to make your “kingdom” the best it can be!

reviews.author: Jason Larned (NJ)
reviews.text: Justin was great all year for us. Highly recommend him and best of luck in the future. We will continue our service as long as he is providing it

reviews.author: Chris Pajer
reviews.text: Hey thanks for stopping by today. Oh wait, you didn’t. No call, no email. Didn’t even show. Not a thing. If I could give negative stars I would. And no, I will not take down this review. Good luck running a business when you don’t show up the day you’re supposed to.

reviews.author: Toby Maniscalco
reviews.text: These guys were amazing. What a great job. It was horrible weather today and they toughed it out and did an amazing job! Price was great for the amount of work they did. I will definitely be booking them for more work. Give these guys a shot!

reviews.author: Allison S
reviews.text: Justin and his team are reliable, friendly, and do a wonderful job. I highly recommend! My grass always looks excellent after their services.

reviews.author: John Dunne
reviews.text: Kingdom has done a great job on our yard. There's nothing better than coming home and seeing perfect cut lines in your yard. They go above and beyond cleaning trimmings as well!

reviews.author: Margarette Charles
reviews.text: No one showed up at my house for 3 consecutive weeks despite saying they were going to come the last 2 weeks. No call / no show, just started mowing on our own.

reviews.author: Anthony Ventura
reviews.text: My first experience having someone other than myself cut my grass and Kingdom Landscaping did an excellent job! Im glad I called them! I've already told a few neighbors about it lol Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Scott Basdeo
reviews.text: Customer service was great. Lyka replies instantly and answers all my questions. I’ll be using them for the next few seasons and definitely recommend.

reviews.author: mariam samaan
reviews.text: Justin is extremely professional and has worked very diligently every time he's cut our lawn. The service is always spot on and I wouldn't trust my yard with anyone else.

reviews.author: Amanda Stone
reviews.text: We’re very happy with the work Justin and his team provided this summer. We will certainly use the business again next summer!

reviews.author: shaunna ellison
reviews.text: Justin’s Landscaping was a great neighborhood find! Professional, quick response, timely and affordable. I would highly recommend his service.

reviews.author: Rachael F
reviews.text: Always on time and professional. Justin is a great guy and it’s been a pleasure working with him for our lawn maintenance.

reviews.author: Trulife Landscaping
reviews.text: Justin teams did an amazing job on my back yard on putting down fresh sod. My backyard hasn't looked this good in 5 years.

reviews.author: MD Lauer
reviews.text: Have no details to share because NO ONE EVEN BOTHERED TO SHOW UP. Luckily landscapers are a dime a dozen, was just hoping a local guy with good reviews would do business like a grown up.

reviews.author: Samantha Mellone
reviews.text: Absolutely love how my grass comes out, and for the amount of grass I have the price is amazing. I highly recommend
